research_question: What is the pooled mean incubation period, in days, of the included adult study cohorts?

review_context.eligibility: Study-level estimates of the incubation period from laboratory-confirmed cases, reported in days or in hours, with a mean estimate and a reported measure of uncertainty.
review_context.exclusions: Estimates reported only as a median or as an interquartile range are not eligible for a pooled mean, and paediatric cohorts are out of scope.
